# Pixor library models (CC0 1.0, no credit required — recorded anyway)

Source: https://pixor.art/library/ (each page states "CC0, no credit needed"). Downloaded 31/10/2026 as GLB and
converted to OBJ/MTL (trimesh) for Unity's built-in importer. Used in 65_PhuQuocIsland (traffic and beach detail).
